Strategy: Crowding-conditioned dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; when at least twenty bins are open, residuals of 1–10 score far below looser fits, since such gaps likely cannot hold future items; otherwise rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when many bins are open and the tightest fit would leave a residual of 1–10. It may help by avoiding waste only when alternatives exist, but may fail if alternatives are rare.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-100.0 + (r - item) if len(bins) >= 20 and r - item <= 10 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Crowding-conditioned dead-zone: penalize residual 1-10 only when >=20 bins open, else Best Fit.
